newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar, Outrider in merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Northstar, Outrider in merger deal.

text.p: Outrider Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it agreed in principle to merge with a subsidiary of Northstar Energy Corp.
Outrider said that its major shareholders, which represent 40 percent of the company's stock, had agreed to vote in favor of the deal.

Under the proposal, Outrider common shareholders would receive special shares of the amalgamated company. The special shares would subsequently be redeemed by the amalgamated firm or bought by Northstar.
Upon redemption or purchase, the former Outrider shareholders would receive C$0.90 per share, subject to adjustment in some circumstances, the company said.
Outrider said the deal was still subject to Northstar's due diligence, negotiation of definitive agreements and shareholder and regulatory approval.
